lims:Section.lims:Content: 34 (1) A permanent resident is inadmissible for (a) one ground; (f) serious criminality as described in this subsection. This fixture text is intentionally longer than the importer's minimum source-text threshold.
35 A person is inadmissible for violating human or international rights. This fixture section supplies a second distinct section identifier.
36 A permanent resident or foreign national is inadmissible on grounds of serious criminality. This fixture section supplies a third distinct section identifier.
